configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Base preset: Ninja generator with standard compiler cache settings

configurePresets.name: vcpkg-base
configurePresets.description: vcpkg-enabled base: Configures CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE and VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR. Required by linux-release and windows-release. Requires: vcpkg repo cloned to ./vcpkg and bootstrapped

configurePresets.name: windows-base
configurePresets.description: Windows base: MSVC x64 with vcpkg and GPU support. Requires: Windows 10/11, MSVC 2022+, Ninja, vcpkg

configurePresets.name: linux-base
configurePresets.description: Linux base: GCC x64 with vcpkg and GPU support. Requires: Linux, GCC 11+, Ninja, vcpkg. Fallback: Use community-release preset with system packages

configurePresets.name: windows-release
configurePresets.description: Production release build for Windows. Requires: Windows 10/11, MSVC 2022+, Ninja, vcpkg. See SETUP.md for setup instructions.

configurePresets.name: windows-debug
configurePresets.description: Development debug build for Windows. Requires: Windows 10/11, MSVC 2022+, Ninja, vcpkg. See SETUP.md for setup instructions.

configurePresets.name: linux-release
configurePresets.description: Production release build for Linux with vcpkg. Requires: Linux, GCC 11+, Ninja, vcpkg. Fallback: Use community-release preset for system package builds. See SETUP.md for setup instructions.

configurePresets.name: linux-debug
configurePresets.description: Development debug build for Linux with vcpkg. Requires: Linux, GCC 11+, Ninja, vcpkg. Fallback: Use community-release preset for system package builds. See SETUP.md for setup instructions.

configurePresets.name: community-release
configurePresets.displayName: Configure: Community Release (system packages, no vcpkg)
configurePresets.description: Fallback preset: Uses system-installed packages instead of vcpkg. Requires: Linux/macOS, GCC/Clang, Ninja, system development packages (librocksdb-dev, libssl-dev, zlib1g-dev, etc.). Use this when vcpkg is unavailable. See SETUP.md for system package installation guide.

configurePresets.name: nightly-bench-sweep
configurePresets.description: Nightly benchmark sweep: Linux release with benchmarks enabled, GPU and LLM disabled. Requires: Linux, GCC 11+, Ninja, vcpkg. See SETUP.md for setup instructions.

configurePresets.name: hyperscaler-debug-windows
configurePresets.description: Hyperscaler debug build for Windows with benchmarks enabled. Requires: Windows 10/11, MSVC 2022+, Ninja, vcpkg. See SETUP.md for setup instructions.

configurePresets.name: hyperscaler-debug-linux
configurePresets.description: Hyperscaler debug build for Linux with benchmarks enabled. Requires: Linux, GCC 11+, Ninja, vcpkg. See SETUP.md for setup instructions.
